title: Love Love Love
text: Love Love Love. I love this blanket. Soft and snuggly. Got the 90x90 so I could wrap up in it.

product_metadata.title: MERRYLIFE Leopard Throw Blanket Decorative Fleece Throw | Ultra-Plush Colorful Oversized | Couch Blanket Travel Lap | (50" 60", Cheetah)
features: ♥ Ultra-Plush Softness – These decorative throw blankets offer beautiful warmth and softness thanks to a 100% polyester fleece fabric that’s light, warm and cozy.
♥ All-Purpose Comfort – Use our throw blankets at home, take them with you in the car, curl up on your back patio, or spread them out at the beach for a nap.
♥ Premier Home Décor – Merrylife throw blankets can be draped over furniture like chairs, couches or beds, enjoyed outdoors in the backyard, or as decorative pieces.

♥ Multiple Choices – Available in a wide variety of colors and styles, choose from Black, Burgundy, Navy, Beige, Grey, Brow, Sky Blue, Cheetah, Plaid and more!And Available in 4 sizes, Throw (50"x60"), Twin (60"x90"), Queen (90"x90") and King (102"x90").
♥ Easy Care and Maintenance – Keep your cute throw blanket looking and smelling brand new by putting in the wash when it’s time. Dry on low heat to maintain style.
